description: This file contains unit tests for activation repartitioning scenarios in an Orleans distributed system. It includes test classes, interfaces, and implementations of grains and stream subscribers used to verify grain movement, placement, and strema interactions under different partitioning scenarios.

classes.name: DefaultToleranceTests
classes.description: Contains unit test methods for activation repartitioning scenarios in Orleans.

classes.name: GrainBase
classes.description: Base class for grains, providing method to get the silo address.

classes.name: A
classes.description: Implementation of grain IA, with methods for initial pinging and interactions based on scenarios.

classes.name: B
classes.description: Implementation of grain IB, with scenario-dependent behavior.

classes.name: C
classes.description: Implementation of grain IC, with methods for pinging with optional target silo.

classes.name: CImmovable
classes.description: Immovable grain of type IC, annotated to stay fixed to certain repartitioning rules.

classes.name: SP
classes.description: Streaming producer grain, which is immovable and pushes stream data.

classes.name: SR
classes.description: Stream subscriber grain, which subscribes to streams and records hits for validation.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture configuring the Orleans test cluster with specific options and services.

methods.name: FirstPing
methods.description: Initial ping setup to assign grain placement in scenarios.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Method for grains to perform a ping operation, scenario-dependent.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the current silo address of the grain.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when grains are activated, used to setup streams.

methods.name: StreamPing
methods.description: Grain method to publish a stream message.

methods.name: GotStreamHit
methods.description: Returns whether the grain has received a stream message.
